cases.claim: “No needles! Goodbye!” | “Goodbye, needle fear.” | SUPER: “Goodbye needles.”
cases.context: Patient Information: get emergency medical help for further treatment after using neffy, which may require injectables. No evidence on needle fear.

cases.check: Judge: absolute 'goodbye/no more' claims vs labeled need for follow-up emergency care; emotional-benefit claims without data.
